Chu's House - Tam Coc: A Hidden Gem with Heartfelt Hospitality in Ninh Binh
Jul 2024 • Solo
This restaurant, Chu's House - Tam Coc, located near where I was staying, truly surprised me. It was a bit quiet, and like many places, they invited me in as I passed by. At that moment, I was craving something more European or American—maybe a pizza or a burger—and that’s probably why I decided to give it a try. Despite this, they also offer local dishes, and what amazed me was that they can whip up something that’s not even on the menu!

Now, let’s talk about the wonderful surroundings and the amazing people. I felt right at home, warmly welcomed by the restaurant’s owner and her family, leaving a lasting impression. I found myself returning to Chu's House constantly during my stay in Ninh Binh. Even when I came back to Ninh Binh a second time, I went straight to them. They make one of the most delicious pizzas I’ve had in Vietnam, fantastic burgers, and their fries—absolutely out of this world!

I remember once I was out and about, and I sent them a message asking if they had any fish dishes. They replied saying they have everything I could want, offered me some options, and when I asked if it was on the menu, they simply said, "No, we made it because you asked!" In short, Chu's House - Tam Coc offers a wonderful atmosphere, a wonderful family, and wonderful people. Definitely worth a visit—I'll be back again!

Great food, excellent service, and truly sincere people. THANK YOU! Oh, and a special shoutout for getting me tickets to the Deadpool & Wolverine movie premiere that day! Thumbs up! You took care of everything from the heart. Best wishes to the old man!
